name: DCA Boudin Bakery Fresh San Fransokyo Sourdough Bread Loaf (Baymax Shape)
brandOrRestaurant: Aunt Cass Café / Boudin Bakery (Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Scratch-baked sourdough made with the original 1849 San Francisco mother dough. Long natural wild yeast fermentation digests wheat fructans, making this one of the most gut-friendly carbs in the resort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pick up a fresh warm sourdough loaf (Mickey or Baymax shape); tear pieces to eat plain or with butter.
watchOuts: None; premier flare-safe theme park carbohydrate
